verdict: FUNCTIONAL CHECKS PASSED - operation CPU and mounted render-resource counts only; managed allocation counter unavailable (allocatedBytes=-1 sentinel), realtime render performance stays unmeasured.
measurement: Editor edit-mode CPU milliseconds only; not frames/FPS/GPU/audio/AI. Initialization, in-memory prewarm, first lethal hit, warm local hit and sustained sequential hits are separate stages. Non-preview instances keep one Rigidbody and enabled compound BoxColliders, but the profiler never calls Physics.Simulate: no automatic physics, contacts or gravity are measured. Managed allocatedBytes are reported only when a positive control verifies GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread; otherwise every allocatedBytes field is the -1 sentinel and no allocation claim is made. Native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and must not be added. First-hit flush totals include full first renderer activation (chunk GameObjects/MeshRenderers created inside the timed call) and are not split into hidden sub-phases.

allocation.note: Positive control did not move GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread (max delta 0 for a requested 1048576 byte array; first delta 0). Unity/Mono reports this counter as unsupported here, so every allocatedBytes field is the -1 sentinel and NO zero-allocation claim is made. CPU timings and functional checks are unaffected. Managed-heap diagnostic (not used for per-operation claims): 1460543488 -> 1462648832.

source.note: JsonUtility.ToJson(VoxelAssetDefinition) and the .asset file bytes were hashed before and after all runtime tests. VoxelTemplateCache was never cleared; entries that existed before the run must still exist afterwards.

notes: Working scenes use the saved empty staging fixture Assets/_Starframe/Tests/Construction/Fixtures/TerrainTestStaging.unity, opened additively; no user scene is saved, replaced or resaved.

Uses Verification loading/hash/cleanup helpers plus a profiler-specific isolated scene setup; it does NOT call VerifyAssets or reuse root-MeshFilter metrics. Physics is never stepped by this profiler.
Phase timings are cumulative runtime diagnostic deltas or direct measurement. Missing metrics stay unavailable; they are never inferred from total Flush time or replaced with zero.

Setup, target selection, diagnostics reflection, scene traversal, conservation and destruction are OUTSIDE timed windows. Managed allocatedBytes are measured only when report.allocation.supported is true; otherwise every allocatedBytes value is the -1 sentinel and no zero-allocation claim is made. No GC.Collect and no global template-cache clear.

Representative templates are kept warm between probes by explicit VoxelTemplateCache leases. Initialization rows are therefore warm-cache, matching the baseline's warm-template limitation; the separate prewarm probe reports the fresh construction cost.

Prewarm resource overhead is reported per asset: prewarmed chunk count, total chunk vertices, estimated generated mesh bytes and the intact aggregate mesh size. Chunk meshes coexist with the intact aggregate until the first lethal hit activates them.

Non-preview EditMode instances keep the original physical contract: one Rigidbody and enabled ACTIVE compound BoxColliders. VoxelTerrainColliders intentionally retains unused pooled components disabled after compaction; they are reported separately and are not part of the active collision volume. The profiler never calls Physics.Simulate and the Editor does not step physics here, so no contact, gravity or gameplay physics is measured. This is not a frame, FPS, GPU, audio or AI measurement.

Per-runtime DetachedVisualCells/DetachedVisualFragmentCount are counted once per runtime. VoxelDetachedVisualFragments.CellCount/FragmentCount are manager-wide and counted once per manager. Render-only admission requires a non-preview runtime, so only the tiny probe opts in.

Collider components are split into activeColliderComponents (runtime ColliderCount, the physical volume) and pooledColliderComponents (disabled retained pool entries after compaction, never physical). Total component count is not a physics budget.

IdleCellVisits is a contractual constant 0, not an observed per-cell visit counter. Idle/expiry no-rebuild evidence is runtime.enabled=false plus unchanged geometry/collider/connectivity build counters, mesh/collider identity and RenderRevision.

Stage CPU times are separate synchronous phases (apply, flush, maintenance, activation) and are not additive into a frame budget. When verified, managed allocation bytes exclude native memory; when unsupported they are the -1 sentinel.

This report is complementary to the preserved five baseline VerifyAssets runs. It does not compute speedups against them: only an identical VerifyAssets probe may be compared directly with that baseline; idle/nonlethal/prewarm/sustained rows here are different probes.

First-hit flush totals include full first renderer activation (chunk GameObjects/MeshRenderers/bindings created inside the timed call). allocatedBytes are managed allocations only when report.allocation.supported; native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and the two must not be added.
Station surface benchmark covers 5 station-like assets: Station_CapsuleTank, Station_NotchedSlab, Station_OpenTruss, Station_EquipmentCage, Station_SphericalTank.
Tiny opt-in probe admitted render-only fragments in EditMode and measured the exact <=4-cell / <=2-world-extent policy.

Measured scenery extent 791.521 x 155.898 x 748.623; largest station-like instance extent 84.861. Round-2 design references are ~2500 map units and ~500 main-station units; a local density patch may be smaller and is not compared automatically.
Density patch reports actual distinct mounted chunk mesh IDs and all instanced vertices/render objects. It does NOT assert the old monolithic 5-unique-mesh count.

before.drawsNote: rendererDrawUpperBound = sum of active MeshRenderer material slots, an upper bound on MeshRenderer draw calls. Real GPU draw calls/batching are not measurable in Editor edit mode. before.visualConservation: Physical cells and per-runtime DetachedVisualCells are counted once per runtime. VoxelDetachedVisualFragments.CellCount/FragmentCount are manager-wide and counted once per manager, never multiplied by the runtime count.
before.physicsNote: Non-preview EditMode instances own one Rigidbody and enabled active compound BoxColliders. VoxelTerrainColliders may retain unused pooled components disabled after compaction: activeColliderComponents is the runtime ColliderCount / active physical volume, pooledColliderComponents are disabled retained components and are NOT physical colliders. The profiler never calls Physics.Simulate, so this is not a physics, contact, gravity or gameplay measurement.
before.drawsNote: rendererDrawUpperBound = sum of active MeshRenderer material slots, an upper bound on MeshRenderer draw calls. Real GPU draw calls/batching are not measurable in Editor edit mode. Visual-fragment draws are submitted by LateUpdate, which the Editor does not run here, so SubmittedDrawCount stays 0 and is not invented.
before.allocationNote: allocatedBytes are current-thread managed allocations only and are valid only when report.allocation.supported is true; otherwise they are the -1 sentinel and must not be interpreted as zero. Native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and is never added to managed bytes.

intact.visualConservation: Physical cells and per-runtime DetachedVisualCells are counted once per runtime. VoxelDetachedVisualFragments.CellCount/FragmentCount are manager-wide and counted once per manager, never multiplied by the runtime count.
intact.physicsNote: Non-preview EditMode instances own one Rigidbody and enabled active compound BoxColliders. VoxelTerrainColliders may retain unused pooled components disabled after compaction: activeColliderComponents is the runtime ColliderCount / active physical volume, pooledColliderComponents are disabled retained components and are NOT physical colliders. The profiler never calls Physics.Simulate, so this is not a physics, contact, gravity or gameplay measurement.
intact.drawsNote: rendererDrawUpperBound = sum of active MeshRenderer material slots, an upper bound on MeshRenderer draw calls. Real GPU draw calls/batching are not measurable in Editor edit mode. Visual-fragment draws are submitted by LateUpdate, which the Editor does not run here, so SubmittedDrawCount stays 0 and is not invented.
intact.allocationNote: allocatedBytes are current-thread managed allocations only and are valid only when report.allocation.supported is true; otherwise they are the -1 sentinel and must not be interpreted as zero. Native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and is never added to managed bytes.
intact.hitTotalNote: First-hit and flush CPU totals include full first renderer activation: chunk GameObjects, MeshFilters, MeshRenderers, materials and bindings are created inside the timed call. They are not split into hidden sub-phases.

intact.visualMeshLimit: Procedural manager draws have no MeshFilter. Owned mesh/material counts are reported once per manager; private mesh vertex data is not exposed and is NOT folded into mounted chunk vertices.
intact.visualConservation: Physical cells and per-runtime DetachedVisualCells are counted once per runtime. VoxelDetachedVisualFragments.CellCount/FragmentCount are manager-wide and counted once per manager, never multiplied by the runtime count.
intact.physicsNote: Non-preview EditMode instances own one Rigidbody and enabled active compound BoxColliders. VoxelTerrainColliders may retain unused pooled components disabled after compaction: activeColliderComponents is the runtime ColliderCount / active physical volume, pooledColliderComponents are disabled retained components and are NOT physical colliders. The profiler never calls Physics.Simulate, so this is not a physics, contact, gravity or gameplay measurement.
intact.drawsNote: rendererDrawUpperBound = sum of active MeshRenderer material slots, an upper bound on MeshRenderer draw calls. Real GPU draw calls/batching are not measurable in Editor edit mode. Visual-fragment draws are submitted by LateUpdate, which the Editor does not run here, so SubmittedDrawCount stays 0 and is not invented.
intact.allocationNote: allocatedBytes are current-thread managed allocations only and are valid only when report.allocation.supported is true; otherwise they are the -1 sentinel and must not be interpreted as zero. Native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and is never added to managed bytes.
intact.hitTotalNote: First-hit and flush CPU totals include full first renderer activation: chunk GameObjects, MeshFilters, MeshRenderers, materials and bindings are created inside the timed call. They are not split into hidden sub-phases.

after.visualConservation: Physical cells and per-runtime DetachedVisualCells are counted once per runtime. VoxelDetachedVisualFragments.CellCount/FragmentCount are manager-wide and counted once per manager, never multiplied by the runtime count.
after.physicsNote: Non-preview EditMode instances own one Rigidbody and enabled active compound BoxColliders. VoxelTerrainColliders may retain unused pooled components disabled after compaction: activeColliderComponents is the runtime ColliderCount / active physical volume, pooledColliderComponents are disabled retained components and are NOT physical colliders. The profiler never calls Physics.Simulate, so this is not a physics, contact, gravity or gameplay measurement.
after.drawsNote: rendererDrawUpperBound = sum of active MeshRenderer material slots, an upper bound on MeshRenderer draw calls. Real GPU draw calls/batching are not measurable in Editor edit mode. Visual-fragment draws are submitted by LateUpdate, which the Editor does not run here, so SubmittedDrawCount stays 0 and is not invented.
after.allocationNote: allocatedBytes are current-thread managed allocations only and are valid only when report.allocation.supported is true; otherwise they are the -1 sentinel and must not be interpreted as zero. Native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and is never added to managed bytes.

dataOnly.note: dataOnly previews retain the hull material palette for editor drawing but must not acquire VoxelTemplateCache, shared chunks, mounted meshes, colliders or a Rigidbody.

tiny.note: Default tinyFragmentMaxCells is 0. When this runtime admits render-only fragments in EditMode, the exact <=4-cell AND full occupied world-bounds extent <=2 policy is measured; otherwise only the default-off/above-threshold physical behaviour is claimed and the eligible branch is reported as unsupported.
